items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Me, Sonny Henry, Piancen, Hyatt and Bone, he'd teach you all of us.

ctx.x: I never done did. Did your band down at the plantation, did they always use the music, the little books?

Yeah, of course. On the little cards. Yeah. The music on the little cards. Professor Umper used to write us, used to teach them. He'd write all those out for you. Yeah. Me, Sonny Henry, Piancen, Hyatt and Bone, he'd teach you all of us.

Do you remember any of the pieces, any of the marches or what kind of music you used, what the pieces were like? We had six eight pieces. Six eight marches and all. Six eight marches, that's how we used either for marches.
